title: WIDGET / Esthetic: 1 space between numbers
symptom: The widget numbers are stuck together without a leading space, making them hard to read when info is long. Also, the information is not centered on the screen; it sticks to the right side. On some devices, the widget needs to be larger to display all information, and the background is too transparent.
fix: The maintainer suggests making the widget wider and playing with system text size, but no specific fix is provided.
evidence_quote: as you see it's different on every phone and probably not possible to create general solution because set of features inside widget is VERY limited compared to application (basicaly Android 2) You may try to play with system text size
